BiblicalUsage: Zabbai is named twice in the Bible, and the passages here are Ezra 10:28; Nehemiah 3:20. In Ezra 10:28 we read, "Of the sons also of Bebai; Jehohanan, Hananiah, Zabbai, and Athlai." It appears again in Nehemiah 3:20: "After him Baruch the son of Zabbai earnestly repaired the other piece..."
TheologicalSignificance: Zabbai is recorded once and kept forever, and I take comfort in that. The Bible does not waste names, and neither does God.
RelatedPeople: Zabbai, Son of Bebai; Zabbai, Father of Baruch
